name: Ping Monitor
blurb: Ping Monitor is a simple tool to monitor your network.
description:
Ping Monitor is a simple tool to monitor your network.

Features:

• Display your ping in real time as a nice chart

• Make it obvious when you're disconnected

• Monitor download and upload speeds

• Display local and public IP addresses

• Automatically detect network and VPN changes

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
